description: Saturating cores on the step-up transformers of the merged GFL converters (the same buses and transformer types as for the VOC and the droop) (the same transformer types in the copy ' - IBRd' as for the droop) (docs/active/PH_CONVERTER_MODEL.md, sections 20-24). Ratings are the PowerFactory types' strn times the elements' ntnum, read from project '39 Bus New England System_final - IBRd', study case GFM_droop, by pf/api/probe_transformer_types.py (outputs/pf/probe_trf_types_IBRd.json, 2026-10-16). Curve: core_curve_gmd (Haddadi et al. 2020, Table IV) on each rating.

types.34: Trf Type 20 - 34 YNy0, 2 x 300 MVA in parallel, uk 10.81 %, 230/16.5 kV

not_cored.34: Trf 20 - 34 (2 x 300 MVA) ends at bus 20, a reduced inductor-only node (series R-L load, no capacitance): a core there needs the two inductor-only nodes reduced together, not implemented (record section 24). Bus 31's converter is not merged (its load) and has no core either.
